watch.label: The Trail Beyond (1934), dir. Robert N. Bradbury

editorial:
The Trail Beyond is a 1934 western distributed by Monogram Pictures, directed by Robert N. Bradbury and produced by Paul Malvern. John Wayne plays Rod Drew, who goes looking for a missing miner (Noah Beery Sr.) and his daughter (Verna Hillie) and gets caught in a fight over a gold mine. Noah Beery Jr., Robert Frazer and Eddie Parker are also in the cast. The film was released on October 22, 1934.

The rights question here is renewal, and it is still open. Searches of the archive.org OCR text of the 1961 and 1962 Catalog of Copyright Entries motion-picture volumes found no renewal for this title. That OCR may not cover each whole volume, and the 1963 volumes have not been checked. The original 1934 registration and notice were also not located, so first publication with a valid notice is unverified. That is why the print is not marked verified. The Copyright Office online catalog covers 1978 onward, so it is not the place to look for a 1961-1963 renewal. The film is also an adaptation of James Oliver Curwood's novel The Wolf Hunters, so the source's own status should be checked before anyone relies on the story layer. Do not assume that a copy found on the Internet Archive settles the matter.
faq: Can I use clips from The Trail Beyond in my own video?

Not yet. Rights status is undetermined. Searches of the 1961 and 1962 renewal volumes found no renewal, but those searches may not cover each whole volume. The 1963 volumes have not been checked, and the 1934 registration and notice were not located. Do not treat this as a finding that the copyright has lapsed. Check the 1963 volumes first, and check the Curwood source novel before you rely on the story.
Does an Internet Archive copy prove the film is free to reuse?
No. Uploads on the Internet Archive do not establish a copyright status. Treat them as places to find a copy and confirm the rights separately.
